regime_read: The pack is crowded with large-cap megacap tech names (MSFT, NVDA, AAPL, AMZN, GOOGL) where the dominant signal is disclosure-driven congressional positioning and broad affiliation rather than unusual activity — a picture of steady accumulation by insiders and politicians, not a tight catalyst. The most idiosyncratic convergence sits in MU (insider buying + unanimous analyst upgrade + patent cluster + StockTwits bull) and, to a lesser degree, AMD (8-Ks + analyst cluster + retail buzz), while LUV carries a rare Trump-linked activist buy.
regime_read_zh: 这份证据包大量集中在超大盘科技股（MSFT、NVDA、AAPL、AMZN、GOOGL），主信号来自披露驱动的国会议员持仓和广泛的关联关系，而非异常活动——这是内部人和政客稳定积累的图景，而非紧致的催化剂。最具特异性的收敛出现在 MU（内部人买入 + 一致分析师上调 + 专利簇 + StockTwits 看多），其次是 AMD（8-K + 分析师簇 + 散户热度），而 LUV 带有罕见的特朗普关联激进投资者买入信号。

theses.thesis: MU has the cleanest unusual-activity convergence in the pack: insider MPI score of 100.0 with a 1.0 analyst-bull ratio and 1.0 StockTwits bull ratio [insider_mspr, analyst_upgrade_cluster, stocktwits_bull]. A disclosed affiliation from Rep. Ro Khanna [actor:Ro Khanna] plus 288 patents and a 3.81x gov-grant acceleration add a policy/subsidy tail. Relative strength of +21.4pp vs SPY is warm but not extended, so entry is not yet gone. This is an insider-cluster + analyst-cluster alignment rather than a macro catalyst.
theses.thesis_zh: MU 拥有证据包中最干净的非正常活动收敛：内部人 MPI 评分为 100.0，分析师看多比 1.0，StockTwits 看多比 1.0 [insider_mspr, analyst_upgrade_cluster, stocktwits_bull]。众议员 Ro Khanna 的披露关联 [actor:Ro Khanna] 加上 288 项专利和 3.81 倍的政府拨款加速，增添了政策/补贴的支撑。相对 SPY +21.4pp 偏暖但未过度延伸，入场窗口尚未关闭。这是内部人簇 + 分析师簇的共振，而非宏观催化剂。
second_order: NVDA — memory/HBM content is the tightest read-through for AI compute; MU is a key HBM supplier
AMD — same DRAM/HBM supply chain and AI accelerator buildout
SMH (semis theme) — a broad memory upcycle from MU would lift the sector
theses.dissent: A perfect bullish consensus (1.0 analyst bull, 1.0 StockTwits bull, 100.0 insider MPI) is itself a contrarian warning — when everyone is already bullish, the marginal buyer may be exhausted, and any HBM pricing wobble would unwind this crowded trade hard.

falsifier.text: MU reports earnings or issues guidance showing DRAM/HBM pricing rolling over, or a disclosed insider sale reverses the insider-cluster signal.

theses.thesis: AMD shows a retail-and-analyst alignment: three 8-K filings in 30 days [material_8k_30d], a 0.94 analyst-bull ratio [analyst_upgrade_cluster], rising GitHub momentum (6,811 stars) [github_momentum], and a 0.84 StockTwits bull ratio on a huge 563,282-watcher base [stocktwits_bull]. It is not extended (-3.6pp vs SPY) so there is no entry-chasing problem. Signals are several independent channels of attention, but the pack gives no fundamental catalyst, so this is a WATCH until the 8-Ks resolve into something concrete.
theses.thesis_zh: AMD 展示了散户与分析师的一致性：30 天内 3 份 8-K 文件 [material_8k_30d]，分析师看多比 0.94 [analyst_upgrade_cluster]，GitHub 动量上升（6,811 stars）[github_momentum]，以及在 563,282 大关注者基础上 0.84 的 StockTwits 看多比 [stocktwits_bull]。其相对 SPY -3.6pp，并未过度延伸，不存在追高问题。这是多个独立的关注度通道，但证据包未给出基本面催化剂，因此在 8-K 落地为具体事项之前保持 WATCH。
second_order: NVDA — AMD's AI accelerator push is the most direct competitive read-through
XLNX-adjacent FPGA/adaptive-compute peers (the 8-Ks may signal M&A or licensing)
theses.dissent: Three 8-Ks in 30 days could signal distress, internal restructuring, or regulatory issues rather than good news — the pack gives no direction on what the filings contain.

falsifier.text: The 8-K contents resolve into something negative (restatement, loss of a key customer, or an adverse legal/regulatory event), or analyst bull ratio drops below 0.7.

theses.thesis: LUV is the only Trump-linked buy in the pack [trump, trump_side=buy], with a disclosed affiliation from activist Paul Singer [actor:Paul Singer] and an unusually strong app-demand channel (4.84 rating, 7.16M reviews) [app_demand]. An activist 13D plus presidential-political alignment is a genuine convergence of two independent channels. Not extended (-1.6pp vs SPY). The missing piece is no insider or analyst confirmation, so this stays a WATCH until the activist thesis becomes public.
theses.thesis_zh: LUV 是证据包中唯一特朗普关联的买入信号 [trump, trump_side=buy]，激进投资者 Paul Singer 的披露关联 [actor:Paul Singer] 以及异常强劲的 app 需求通道（4.84 评分，716 万评论）[app_demand]。激进投资者 13D 加上总统政治层面的共振，是两个独立通道的真正收敛。相对 SPY -1.6pp，未过度延伸。缺失的是内部人或分析师的确认，因此在激进投资者论点公开之前保持 WATCH。
second_order: DAL — a LUV activist re-rating would lift the low-cost carrier complex broadly
JETS (airlines ETF theme) — sector re-rating from a high-profile activist campaign
theses.dissent: Trump-linked sentiment is noisy and reversible; an activist stake without a disclosed plan carries no fundamental catalyst, and airline app demand can simply reflect summer travel seasonality.

falsifier.text: Singer's 13D reveals a passive stake or an exit, or LUV guides down on unit revenue / fuel costs in the next earnings print.

theses.thesis: RSG has a strong insider-sale cluster — 19 insider buyers reported but paired with a $262.7M insider net position [insider_net_usd, insider_buyers=19] and a Trump-side 'sell' tag [trump, trump_side=sell]. The combination of Trump-linked selling plus a large insider-net-USD negative is a convergence in the wrong direction. Not extended (-0.3pp). This is a defensive waste-management staple; the unusual activity points to distribution rather than accumulation.
theses.thesis_zh: RSG 存在强劲的内部人卖出簇——报告了 19 位内部人买入者，但对应 2.627 亿美元的内部人净持仓 [insider_net_usd, insider_buyers=19] 以及特朗普侧 'sell' 标签 [trump, trump_side=sell]。特朗普关联卖出加上大规模内部人净美元为负，是方向错误的收敛。相对 SPY -0.3pp，未过度延伸。这是防御性的垃圾管理大盘股；异常活动指向派发而非吸筹。
second_order: WM — sector read-through if RSG insider selling signals a broader waste-services valuation top
Utilities/defensives (XLU) — a defensive staple seeing insider distribution is a risk-off tell
theses.dissent: Insider-net-USD metrics can be distorted by one large grant vesting or option exercise; without filing detail the sell signal may be noise, and waste management is a classic low-beta compounder that shrugs off sentiment.

falsifier.text: SEC filings show the insider-net-USD was driven by option exercises or estate planning rather than open-market sales, or RSG raises guidance.

theses.thesis: MSFT has the highest convergence score (6) and weighted score (2.25) in the pack, driven by six channels including app demand (4.77 rating, ~20M reviews), GitHub momentum (188,941 stars), HF model momentum (33.6M downloads/30d), patent cluster (318), and lobbying ($3.65M) [app_demand, github_momentum, hf_model_momentum, patent_cluster, lobbying]. The signal is broad affiliation (Sam Altman, Bill Ackman) plus steady congressional accumulation (~$1.05B position) [actor:Sam Altman, actor:Bill Ackman, congress_position_usd]. But this is a disclosure-heavy megacap read rather than unusual activity — every channel is already priced and consensus. Not extended (+12.3pp). WATCH, because there is no idiosyncratic catalyst to buy.
theses.thesis_zh: MSFT 拥有证据包中最高的收敛得分（6）和加权得分（2.25），由六个通道驱动，包括 app 需求（4.77 评分，约 2000 万评论）、GitHub 动量（188,941 stars）、HF 模型动量（30 天 3363 万次下载）、专利簇（318）、以及游说（365 万美元）[app_demand, github_momentum, hf_model_momentum, patent_cluster, lobbying]。信号是广泛的关联（Sam Altman、Bill Ackman）加上稳定的国会增持（约 10.5 亿美元持仓）[actor:Sam Altman, actor:Bill Ackman, congress_position_usd]。但这主要是披露密集的超大盘股读数，而非异常活动——每个通道都已被定价并形成共识。相对 SPY +12.3pp 未过度延伸。保持 WATCH，因为没有特异性的买入催化剂。
second_order: OpenAI-adjacent names — MSFT's Altman partnership is the clearest second-order AI read [actor:Sam Altman]
NVDA — the AI infra complex MSFT's capex supports
GOOGL — competing hyperscaler lifts with AI model momentum
theses.dissent: A six-channel convergence on a megacap is consensus, not edge — the more channels that light up on MSFT, the less alpha remains; at these scale metrics nothing is unusual.

falsifier.text: MSFT guides Azure/AI growth below consensus, or its OpenAI partnership restructures in a way that removes exclusivity.
